explication: Waterfox is a customizable browser built on Mozilla platform code. Its principal user workflow is browser interaction leading to page and DOM activity, with platform services supporting storage, media, and accessibility. The tree also shows browser startup, content-process actors, security, and browser customization. The graph preserves these as distinct subsystems, but most browser-to-platform call paths were not sampled; those relationships are shown as unverified rather than asserted. The README identifies the product but documents few runtime details.
